database.raw_text:
All applications for the current positions should be submitted to the personnel
section ------- triplicate and in separate envelopes.
(A) by
(B) in
(C) on
(D) to
database.explanation:
triplicate是表示“一式三份，三倍”的名词，一般与介词
in连用后充当状语。in triplicate意为“一式三份”，in duplicate意
为“一式两份”，in quadruplicate意为“一式四份”。
